# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> New to the market with Richard Mulhall of RE/MAX Partners, 18 The Court, is a charming three-bedroom mid-terrace home nestled within a quiet Cul de sac. No.18 comes to the market in great condition throughout and benefits with brand new gas central heating system.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 100.8 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 18 The Court, Moyglare Hall, Maynooth
- Cena: 395 000 €
